### FREE educational resources

ASTIN Academy provides high-quality educational materials in non-life insurance free of charge to aspiring actuaries around the world. As a new initiative, it has curated and published a list of freely accessible resources in actuarial science, including books, lecture notes, tutorials, datasets, videos, and other educational materials. This list was compiled by Nii Okine and Elizabeth Baafi.
To view the list, [click here](https://openacttexts.github.io/LDAVer2/ASTINFreeResources.html).

### mqriskR

<!-- badges: start -->
[![CRAN status](https://www.r-pkg.org/badges/version/mqriskR)](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=mqriskR)
<!-- badges: end -->




`mqriskR` provides functions for actuarial risk modeling, including survival models, life annuities, multiple-decrement models, and mortality improvement projections, using standard actuarial notation.

The package is designed to support teaching, exam preparation, and reproducible actuarial analysis.

Full function documentation is available on the pkgdown site:

<https://aokine.github.io/mqriskR/>
